About the Good Weather Sunday Social group ride

An all-inclusive casual ride from Tailwind Cafe on Capitol Hill with rotating leaders and a new route each week. Park sits and pastry stops are part of the plan. Rain or shine; ice or snow cancels.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
